statement: Investigate layered PSD as the exchange route for finite artboards/selected areas while preserving the native UNRULY board as editable master.
Unexpired browser HTTP-cache entries may be reused by cache.addAll at stable asset URLs; Request(cache:reload) is the bounded proposed repair. Not yet deterministically reproduced in CI2.

After smudge, estimate 6–9 focused checkpoints for everyday personal drawing and approximately 12–20 for the full browser vision. Counts are provisional planning estimates, not approved fixed schedules. Native packaging/proprietary compatibility excluded pending feasibility. Proposed next focus: raster capacity/layer masks.
